parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among all requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not set this parameter, **ClientToken** is set to the value of **RequestId**. The value of **RequestId** for each API request is different.

parameters.name: EndpointConfigurations
parameters.description:
The information about the endpoints.

You can specify information for up to 20 endpoints.

parameters.name: EndpointGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint group in which to create endpoints.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga create-custom-routing-endpoints --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --endpoint-group-id epg-bp1bpn0kn908w4nb0000 --endpoint-configurations '[{"Type":"PrivateSubNet","Endpoint":"vsw-test01","PolicyConfigurations":[{"Address":"10.0.XX.XX","PortRanges":[{"FromPort":80,"ToPort":80}]}],"TrafficToEndpointPolicy":"DenyAll"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ga CreateCustomRoutingEndpoints --region cn-hangzhou --EndpointConfigurations.1.Endpoint 'vsw-test01' --EndpointGroupId 'epg-bp1bpn0kn908w4nb0000' --EndpointConfigurations.1.PolicyConfigurations.1.PortRanges.1.FromPort 80 --EndpointConfigurations.1.PolicyConfigurations.1.PortRanges.1.ToPort 80 --EndpointConfigurations.1.TrafficToEndpointPolicy DenyAll --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --EndpointConfigurations.1.PolicyConfigurations.1.Address '10.0.XX.XX' --EndpointConfigurations.1.Type PrivateSubNet
